source: President Gerald Ford attempts to win election to office after replacing Richard Nixon in 1974, and narrowly defeating Ronald Reagan for the Republican nomination. Jimmy Carter is a new face on the national scene, having served as Governor of Georgia. He will make the case that the nation needs new blood after the scandals of the Nixon era. Both candidates are seen as moderate by the standards of their party. The battleground states are in the West, the Midwest, and the Northeast.
zh: 杰拉尔德·福特总统于1974年接替理查德·尼克松，随后险胜罗纳德·里根，获得共和党提名。如今，他希望通过选举正式赢得总统职位。曾任佐治亚州州长的吉米·卡特是全国政坛的新面孔。他将强调，经历尼克松时代的丑闻后，美国需要新鲜血液。按各自党内的标准，两人都属于温和派。主要战场位于西部、中西部和东北部。

source: Jimmy Carter has served as Governor of Georgia for one term, and has never held an elected office in Washington. In an era of public disgust with Watergate, Vietnam, and the economy, Carter has used his outsider status to win the Democratic nomination. He is an outspoken Southern Baptist, and a moderate within the party on social and economic issues. He begins with an early lead in the polls against Gerald Ford.
zh: 吉米·卡特做过一届佐治亚州州长，从未在华盛顿担任民选公职。公众厌恶水门事件、越南战争和糟糕的经济，卡特借助政坛局外人的身份赢得了民主党提名。他公开信奉美南浸信会，在党内的社会与经济议题上属于温和派。竞选初期，他在民调中领先于杰拉尔德·福特。

source:
Congratulations! You have won the 1976 Presidential Election.

Hopefully you can make good on your promises to clean up Washington and change the political and moral culture of the country. If you are successful, there is no reason you cannot run for reelection in 1980. Just be wary of any economic problems, or of some foreign policy crisis that could dent your popularity.
zh:
恭喜！您赢得了 1976 年总统选举。

但愿你能兑现承诺，整顿华盛顿政坛，改变这个国家的政治与道德风气。如果做得成功，你完全可以在1980年争取连任。只是要留意经济问题，以及可能损害你声望的外交危机。

source:
Sorry, you have lost the 1976 Presidential Election.

As an outsider candidate, this was really your moment to make an impact on American politics and to win a national election. The beltway gossip already has it that Ted Kennedy is the frontrunner for the 1980 nomination. Perhaps you can run again for Governor of Georgia, or make an impact in some other way.
zh:
抱歉，您在 1976 年总统选举中失败了。

作为一名局外候选人，这确实是你对美国政治产生影响并赢得全国大选的时刻。环城高速的传闻已经表明特德·肯尼迪是 1980 年提名的领跑者。也许你可以再次竞选佐治亚州州长，或者以其他方式产生影响。

source:
Wow! You have won in a squeaker.

While the Electoral College ended in a tie, the Democrats have a huge advantage in the House of Representatives and are sure to elect you in that manner. Hopefully the closeness of this election doesn't undermine your promises to clean up Washington and unite the people of this country.
zh:
哇！你在吱吱声中获胜了。

虽然选举人团投票打成平局，民主党在众议院拥有巨大优势，肯定会通过众议院选举让你当选。但愿这场选举的胶着，不会损害你整顿华盛顿政坛、团结美国人民的承诺。

source:
Congratulations! You have won the 1976 Presidential Election.

Hopefully you can continue to help the United States recover from the Watergate Scandal, the recent recession, and the debacle of Vietnam. In either case, this will be your final term as President. Speculation is sure to be intense on who will replace you. Will it be Ronald Reagan? Ted Kennedy? Or someone else entirely?
zh:
恭喜！您赢得了 1976 年总统选举。

希望您能继续帮助美国从水门事件丑闻、最近的经济衰退和越南的崩溃中恢复过来。无论哪种情况，这都将是您作为总统的最后一个任期。关于谁将取代你的猜测肯定会很激烈。会是罗纳德·里根吗？特德·肯尼迪？还是完全是别人？

source:
Sorry, you have lost the 1976 Presidential Election.

Hopefully your opponent can make good on his promises to clean up Washington and change the political and moral culture of the country. Perhaps you can still play a role in 1980, or seek your old Congressional leadership positions. In any case, you can still take solace in the fact that you did the right thing by pardoning Nixon and moving the country beyond the Watergate episode.
zh:
抱歉，您在 1976 年总统选举中失败了。

但愿你的对手能兑现承诺，整顿华盛顿政坛，改变这个国家的政治与道德风气。或许你在1980年仍能发挥作用，或者谋求重返原来的国会领导职位。无论如何，你仍可以宽慰自己：赦免尼克松、让国家走出水门事件的阴影，是正确的决定。

source:
Sorry, you have lost the 1976 Presidential Election.

While the Electoral College ended in a tie, the Democrats have a huge advantage in the House of Representatives and are sure to elect your opponent in that manner. Perhaps you can still play a role in 1980, or seek your old Congressional leadership positions. In any case, you can still take solace in the fact that you did the right thing by pardoning Nixon and moving the country beyond the Watergate episode.
zh:
抱歉，您在 1976 年总统选举中失败了。

虽然选举人团投票打成平局，民主党在众议院拥有巨大优势，肯定会通过众议院选举让你的对手当选。或许你在1980年仍能发挥作用，或者谋求重返原来的国会领导职位。无论如何，你仍可以宽慰自己：赦免尼克松、让国家走出水门事件的阴影，是正确的决定。

source: Sorry, you lost the 1976 election.
zh: 抱歉，你输掉了 1976 年的选举。

source: I can't fuckin think of anything funny for Ford, he is so bland, just pretend this gif is playing and he is falling down the stairs.
zh: 我他妈想不出福特有什么好笑的，他太平淡了，就假装这个 gif 正在播放，他从楼梯上摔下来。

source: The year is 1984
zh: 年份是 1984 年

source: Jimmy Carter has been president for 8 years. Inflation has subsided to a steady amount, with unemployment dropping to virtually 0%. The budget had been balanced in 78, and poverty and hunger have been eradicated, as everyone unemployed became a farmer, and is eating peanut butter and peach jam sandwiches. the USSR on the 21st of January had seceded all their land to the USA and declared their government dissolved. Most importantly of all, the government is now trusted more than ever under the leadership of Jimmy Carter, who beat up Richard Nixon on live TV in 1981, garnering a 99% approval rating. Mondale has already won the most recent election 873 electoral votes to 0 against those sorry Republicans, who disbanded shortly after. All is good in the world, thanks to our wonderful leader, Jimmy Carter.
zh: 吉米·卡特已担任总裁 8 年。通货膨胀已稳定下来，失业率几乎降至 0%。 78年预算已经平衡，贫困和饥饿已经消除，每个失业者都成了农民，吃着花生酱和桃子酱三明治。 1月21日，苏联将所有土地割让给美国，并宣布政府解散。最重要的是，在吉米·卡特的领导下，政府现在比以往任何时候都更受信任，他于1981年在电视直播中击败了理查德·尼克松，获得了99%的支持率。蒙代尔在最近的选举中已经以 873 比 0 的选举人票战胜了那些令人遗憾的共和党人，后者不久后就解散了。世界上一切都美好，感谢我们出色的领导者，吉米·卡特。

source: Congratulations! You won the 1976 election!
zh: 恭喜！你赢得了 1976 年的选举！

source: Congratulations! Even though you were the favourite from the start, you could have faltered in several ways. You've carried the will of the country and sent a clear message to those DC insiders. They'll need to tread carefully, as the impressive turnaround from 72, despite the playboy interview, shows what America thinks of Ol' Dick Nixon's cronies.
zh: 恭喜！尽管你从一开始就是最受欢迎的，但你可能会在几个方面陷入困境。你承载了国家的意愿，并向华盛顿特区内部人士发出了明确的信息。他们需要谨慎行事，因为尽管接受了《花花公子》的采访，72 年后的令人印象深刻的转变表明了美国人对老迪克尼克松亲信的看法。

source: Congratulations! Even though you were the favourite from the start, you could have faltered in a number of ways. You've carried the will of the country and sent a clear message to those DC insiders. As expected, your Playboy interview prevented a glorious decimation of the Republicans, but you'll take it, seeing as it could have been worse with the economic recovery.
zh: 恭喜！尽管你从一开始就是最受欢迎的，但你可能会在很多方面陷入困境。你承载了国家的意愿，并向华盛顿特区内部人士发出了明确的信息。正如预期的那样，你的《花花公子》采访阻止了共和党的光荣灭亡，但你会接受它，因为随着经济复苏，情况可能会更糟。

source: Congratulations! Even though you were the favourite from the start, you could have faltered in several ways. You've carried the will of the country and sent a clear message to those DC insiders. Many were shocked at the tightness of the election, seeing as the negativity around the GOP and DC in general. Maybe you were TOO honest, Jimmy...
zh: 恭喜！尽管你从一开始就是最受欢迎的，但你可能会在几个方面陷入困境。你承载了国家的意愿，并向华盛顿特区内部人士发出了明确的信息。许多人对选举的激烈程度感到震惊，认为共和党和华盛顿特区总体上存在消极情绪。也许你太诚实了，吉米……

source: Interestingly enough, Ford ended up winning the popular vote. Republicans are more shocked than angry. Perhaps passing a new version of the Bayh-Celler amendment can be among your reforms?
zh: 有趣的是，福特最终赢得了民众投票。共和党人更多的是震惊而不是愤怒。也许通过新版本的贝赫-Celler 修正案可以成为您的改革之一？

source: You still have many options, despite your defeat, as your jolt to the Democrats nomination and the new focus on character in politics will allow you to expand your horizons. While you might not run for president again in four years, a Senate seat in Georgia could suit you very well. Returning to the governor of the state also is possible. Perhaps all the campaigning and stress will inspire you to return to your peanut farm.
zh: 尽管你失败了，但你仍然有很多选择，因为你获得民主党提名以及对政治性格的新关注将使你扩大视野。虽然您可能在四年内不会再次竞选总统，但佐治亚州的参议院席位可能非常适合您。重返州长职位也是可能的。也许所有的竞选活动和压力都会激励您返回花生农场。

source: The public just didn't think you were up to the task. That's the tradeoff with running a DC outsider like yourself, and the scale tipped in Fords' favour. He will have 4 more years to slash inflation and defend his reputation. He will have to be cautious and show restraint, as you came close to beating him. He with have the public breathing down his neck and Watergate looming over him for his term.
zh: 公众只是认为你无法胜任这项任务。这是与像你这样的华盛顿外来者进行权衡，而规模对福特有利。他还有四年的时间来削减通货膨胀并捍卫自己的声誉。当你差点击败他时，他必须保持谨慎并表现出克制。他的任期受到公众的关注，水门事件也笼罩着他。

source: The public just didn't think you were up to the task. That's the tradeoff with running a DC outsider like yourself, and the scale tipped in Fords' favour. Many Democrats are wondering if Watergate might have affected the Republicans more than DC as a  whole, and more standard Democrats could have won this. certainly, your Playboy scandal makes them question nominating someone few people knew.
zh: 公众只是认为你无法胜任这项任务。这是与像你这样的华盛顿外来者进行权衡，而规模对福特有利。许多民主党人想知道水门事件对共和党的影响是否可能比整个华盛顿特区更大，而更标准的民主党人可能会赢得这场胜利。当然，你的《花花公子》丑闻让他们质疑提名一个很少有人知道的人。

source: The public just didn't think you were up to the task. That's the tradeoff with running a DC outsider like yourself, and the scale tipped in Fords' favour. Lots of Democrats are incredibly angered that you could lose by such a margin, and are accusing you of throwing away the presidency with a single interview.
zh: 公众只是认为你无法胜任这项任务。这是与像你这样的华盛顿外来者进行权衡，而规模对福特有利。许多民主党人对你以如此大的差距落败感到非常愤怒，并指责你仅仅通过一次采访就放弃了总统宝座。

source: If it wasn't already bad enough for you, the popular votes ended up going in your favour. The public and the Democrats are enraged and in despair, as the will of the people to remove the man who pardon Nixon failed. If the Bayh-Celler amendment didn't pass previously, surely the support to pass it will be present now?
zh: 如果这对你来说还不够糟糕的话，那么民众的投票最终对你有利。公众和民主党人感到愤怒和绝望，因为人们想要罢免赦免者尼克松的意愿失败了。如果贝赫-Celler修正案之前没有通过，现在肯定会得到通过它的支持吗？

source: Your quick thrusting into the political limelight and downfall was certainly dramatic. It's up to you what you do next. Perhaps a return to the house, although maybe not in a leadership role. A run in fours years is unlikely with Reagan and his coalition ready to nominate him. Perhaps he might extend an olive branch to you as you did to the conservatives this election, and consider you for his vice presidency?
zh: 你迅速进入政治聚光灯和垮台无疑是戏剧性的。接下来做什么取决于你。也许会回到家里，尽管可能不会担任领导职务。由于里根和他的联盟准备提名他，四年内的竞选不太可能。也许他可能会像这次选举中你向保守派那样向你伸出橄榄枝，并考虑你担任副总统？

source: Despite your best efforts, Jimmy Carter has bested you, making you the only president never elected to office. The toll of Watergate and Vietnam was just too much for you to handle. The recovering economy, however, made this election quite close, so you can take solace in the fact that you went down swinging.
zh: 尽管你已竭尽全力，吉米·卡特还是击败了你，使你成为唯一一位从未通过选举获得这一职位的总统。水门事件和越南问题留下的重担，实在难以承受。不过，经济复苏使本届选举格外胶着；至少，你奋战到了最后，这一点足以宽慰自己。

source: Despite your best efforts, Jimmy Carter has bested you, making you the only president never elected to office. The toll of Watergate and Vietnam was just too much for you to handle. America showed they wanted an outsider, and Carter managed to take that title. Let's hope he can help restore faith in government, and help the inflation die down.
zh: 尽管你已竭尽全力，吉米·卡特还是击败了你，使你成为唯一一位从未通过选举获得这一职位的总统。水门事件和越南问题留下的重担，实在难以承受。美国人表明，他们想要一位政坛局外人，而卡特成功树立了这一形象。但愿他能重建公众对政府的信任，并缓解通货膨胀。

source: Despite your best efforts, Jimmy Carter has bested you, making you the only president never elected to office. The toll of Watergate and Vietnam was just too much for you to handle. Your Watergate pardon might go down as one of the most blunderous moves in political history, as otherwise, you might have been able to disassociate yourself with Nixon. You, accordingly, got beaten by a larger than expected margin.
zh: 尽管你已竭尽全力，吉米·卡特还是击败了你，使你成为唯一一位从未通过选举获得这一职位的总统。水门事件和越南问题留下的重担，实在难以承受。你赦免尼克松的决定，或许会成为政治史上最严重的失误之一；否则，你本可以设法与尼克松划清界限。结果，你败选的差距比预期更大。

source: Wow! Defying the odds, you have beaten back the Democrats to secure yet another term for your party. After the Watergate pardon, most thought you were done for, but you proved them wrong. You won by a quite shocking margin. It seems your rose garden strategy worked well.
zh: 哇！你们不顾一切，击退了民主党，为你们的政党赢得了连任。在水门事件赦免之后，大多数人都认为你完蛋了，但你证明他们错了。你以惊人的优势获胜。看来你的玫瑰园策略很有效。

source: Wow! Defying the odds, you have beaten back the Democrats to secure yet another term for your party. After the Watergate pardon, most thought you were done for, but you proved them wrong. Carter put up a strong fight, however, and without the Playboy scandal, you likely wouldn't have won. The Democrats are sure to make some electoral changes after two outsiders in a row preventing them from winning...
zh: 哇！你们不顾一切，击退了民主党，为你们的政党赢得了连任。在水门事件赦免之后，大多数人都认为你完蛋了，但你证明他们错了。卡特然而，如果没有花花公子丑闻，你可能不会赢。在两名局外人连续阻止民主党获胜后，民主党肯定会做出一些选举改变……

source: Wow! Defying the odds, you have beaten back the Democrats to secure yet another term for your party. After the Watergate pardon, most thought you were done for, but you proved them wrong. You barely squeaked by, however. Carter gave you a run for your money, and congress isn't too friendly towards you either, so you better tread carefully.
zh: 哇！你们不顾一切，击退了民主党，为你们的政党赢得了连任。在水门事件赦免之后，大多数人都认为你完蛋了，但你证明他们错了。然而，你勉强勉强过去了。卡特给你的钱带来了竞争，国会对你也不太友好，所以你最好小心行事。

source: You can hopefully expand upon the recovery from stagflation in your second term, and hopefully bring honour back to the white house. It won't be an easy feat with your pardon, but America wants to give you a chance. Do well and you might be remembered for more than Nixon's pardon.
zh: 您有望在第二个任期内扩大滞胀复苏，并有望为白宫带来荣誉。赦免你并不是一件容易的事，但美国想给你一个机会。如果做得好，你可能会因为尼克松的赦免而被记住。

source: You have selected Walter Mondale as your running mate. Can you speak a little more about that?
zh: 您已选择沃尔特·蒙代尔作为您的竞选搭档。您能多谈谈吗？

source: What will be your overall campaign strategy this year?
zh: 今年您的总体竞选策略是什么？

source: A lot of voters are concerned about honesty and integrity in our government. What can you say about yourself in this aspect?
zh: 许多选民担心我们政府的诚实和正直。在这方面您对自己有何评价？

source: What is your position on the federal government making loans to states or cities in need of financial help? An obvious recent example is the $2.3 billion bailout of New York city.
zh: 对于联邦政府向需要财政帮助的州或城市提供贷款，您持什么立场？最近一个明显的例子是对纽约州城市的 23 亿美元救助。

source: What is your opinion on abortion, and specifically the recent Roe v. Wade decision?
zh: 您对堕胎有何看法，特别是最近的堕胎 罗诉韦德案 决定？

source: Would you support a law for universal health care in this country?
zh: 您会支持这个国家的全民医疗保健法律吗？

source: Do you support the Humphrey-Hawkins Full Employment Act?
zh: 您支持汉弗莱-霍金斯充分就业法案吗？

source: What is your opinion on the court-ordered busing of students within school districts, in a way designed to achieve racial balance in our schools?
zh: 您对法院下令在学区内载送学生以实现学校种族平衡的做法有何看法？

source: Do you believe that the United States can afford a reduction in defense spending?
zh: 您认为美国能够承受国防开支的削减吗？

source: What is your position on a pardon of Vietnam War draft evaders?
zh: 您对于赦免越南战争逃兵者的立场是什么？

source: Do you support the ratification of the Equal Rights Amendment, which states "Equality of rights under the law shall not be denied or abridged by the United States or by any State on account of sex."?
zh: 您是否支持批准《平等权利修正案》，该修正案规定“美国或任何州不得因性别而否认或削弱法律规定的权利平等”？

source: In the next issue of Playboy, there's an interview where you used the words "screw" and "shack up" and confessed, "I've committed adultery in my heart..." Many of your religious supporters are furious. What can you say to explain yourself?
zh: 在下一期《花花公子》的采访中，您使用了“拧”和“同居”等词并承认，“我在心里犯了通奸……”您的许多宗教支持者都感到愤怒。你能说什么来解释自己？

source: In your infamous Playboy interview, you also referred to Lyndon Johnson as "lying, cheating, and distorting the truth." This might make you look honest, but it could destroy your chances of winning Texas if you don't apologize.
zh: 在您臭名昭著的《花花公子》采访中，您还将林登·约翰逊称为“撒谎、欺骗和歪曲事实”。这可能会让你看起来很诚实，但如果你不道歉，它可能会破坏你获胜的机会得克萨斯州。

source: There is talk of a Presidential Debate for the first time since 1960. Is this something that you're interested in doing?
zh: 自 1960 年以来第一次有人谈论总统辩论。您有兴趣这样做吗？

source: You've recently appeared with George Wallace, infamous Governor of Alabama, on the campaign trail. What do you have to say about that?
zh: 你最近与臭名昭著的阿拉巴马州州长乔治·华莱士一起出现在竞选活动中。对此你有什么想说的？

source: General George Brown, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, has made some comments that Israel has become a "burden" to the national defense effort. Do you agree with this?
zh: 参谋长联席会议主席乔治·布朗将军发表评论称，以色列已成为国防努力的“负担”。你同意这一点吗？

source: What are your feelings in the Gregg v. Georgia case, recently decided, that allows capital punishment in the U.S.?
zh: 你的感受是什么 格雷格诉佐治亚州 最近判决的案件允许在美国判处死刑？

source: What is your position on right-to-work laws? Would you support a national bill to repeal Taft-Hartley and do away with right-to-work?
zh: 您对工作权法律的立场是什么？您会支持废除塔夫脱-哈特利法案并废除工作权的国家法案吗？

source: Should there be a ban on nuclear weapons testing?
zh: 是否应该禁止核武器试验？

source: Could we have done more to save South Vietnam in 1975, such as air strikes or a limited engagement?
zh: 1975 年我们是否可以采取更多措施来拯救南越，例如空袭或有限的交战？

source: How can we best prevent another episode like the 1973 oil crisis, which paralyzed the country?
zh: 我们如何才能最好地防止再次发生像 1973 年石油危机那样导致国家瘫痪的事件？

source: The United States started selling large amounts of grain to the Soviet Union, in 1973. What is your opinion on this policy?
zh: 美国从1973年开始向苏联出售大量粮食。您对这一政策有何看法？

source: In 1972, George McGovern proposed replacing the income tax exemption with a $1,000 guaranteed minimum income, for every American citizen. Are you interested in this type of proposal?
zh: 1972 年，乔治·麦戈文 (George McGovern) 提议用每位美国公民 1,000 美元的最低保障收入取代所得税豁免。您对此类提案感兴趣吗？

source: On the Sunday before election day, your church has canceled its services rather than admit a black minister as a member. Will you terminate your own membership?
zh: 在选举日前夕，您的教会取消了礼拜活动，而不是接纳黑人牧师为会员。您会终止自己的会员资格吗？

source: Where will you focus your efforts on the last day before the election?
zh: 选举前的最后一天，您将把精力集中在哪里？

source: People want an outsider in government. I'm in a unique position to unite the country and move it towards a newer, more open chapter in its history.
zh: 人们希望政府中有一个局外人。我处于一个独特的位置，可以团结这个国家并推动其历史上更新、更加开放的篇章。

source: I know a lot of Democrats are concerned that I'm too moderate. I will make it a point to express support for a staunch liberal platform this fall.
zh: 我知道很多民主党人担心我过于温和。今年秋天，我将重点表达对坚定的自由主义纲领的支持。

source: I won my party's nomination as a moderate, conciliatory politician. We will continue this strategy in the general election, and above all we'll avoid the mistakes of McGovern in '72.
zh: 我作为温和、和解的政治家赢得了党派的提名。我们将在大选中继续这一策略，最重要的是我们将避免麦戈文在 72 年犯下的错误。

source: Gerald Ford pardoned Nixon, vetoed a school lunch program, and selected Bob Dole as his running mate. We need to remind the American people that he is far too much of a conservative insider to be President.
zh: 杰拉尔德·福特赦免了尼克松，否决了学校午餐计划，并选择鲍勃·多尔作为他的竞选搭档。我们需要提醒美国人民，他是一位过于保守的内部人士，不适合担任总统。

source: I will never tell a lie to the American people. My Southern Baptist faith and my family have guided me for my entire life. I will make sure my biography and home town get heavy coverage in our advertisements.
zh: 我永远不会对美国人民撒谎。我的美南浸信会信仰和我的家人引导了我一生。我将确保我的传记和家乡在我们的广告中得到大量报道。

source: Honesty and integrity is good, but voters want to hear about solutions. I have common-sense answers to our nation's problems.
zh: 诚实和正直很好，但选民希望听到解决方案。我对我们国家的问题有常识性的答案。

source: We have a President in the White House who pardoned the most notorious liar in our nation's history. The previous President, Lyndon Johnson, lied our country into Vietnam. I will be a different kind of President.
zh: 我们的白宫总统赦免了我们国家历史上最臭名昭著的骗子。前总统，林登·约翰逊，欺骗我们的国家进入越南。我将成为一位不同类型的总统。

source: Not really. We're starting this campaign with a huge lead. I'd rather not roll the dice on that.
zh: 并非如此。我们以巨大的领先优势开始这场活动。我宁愿不为此掷骰子。

source: I think this is a good idea that will show I'm serious about openness in government.
zh: 我认为这是一个好主意，它将表明我对政府开放的认真态度。

source: Anyone can see that I am a strong supporter of Civil Rights. I don't agree with what Wallace did, but my campaign is about healing this nation and bringing all sides together to face the future.
zh: 任何人都可以看到我是民权的坚定支持者。我不同意华莱士的做法，但我的竞选活动是为了治愈这个国家并让各方团结起来面对未来。

source: I've appeared with George Wallace, just the same as I've appeared with any other Democrat who sought our nomination this year. People don't need to read any special significance into this.
zh: 我与乔治·华莱士一起出现，就像我与今年寻求提名的任何其他民主党人一起出现一样。人们不需要对此有任何特殊的意义。

source: We might have our differences, but we have both been the Governors of Southern states, and it is important for us to show our camaraderie.
zh: 我们可能有分歧，但我们都曾担任过南方各州的州长，对我们来说表现出友情很重要。

source: I think the interview speaks for itself. We need to focus on the issues and not on tabloid gossip.
zh: 我认为采访本身就说明了一切。我们需要关注问题而不是小报八卦。

source: I will apologize and admit that Playboy was not the best forum to discuss my Christian faith.
zh: 我会道歉并承认花花公子不是讨论我的基督教信仰的最佳论坛。

source: I was trying to have an honest conversation about the challenges of living a righteous life. I think once people stop and think about it, they will understand that.
zh: 我试图就过正义生活的挑战进行诚实的对话。我想一旦人们停下来思考一下，他们就会明白这一点。

source: I meant what I said, and it's unfortunate that it has to be a big issue with some folks. But I told the American people, "I will never tell a lie."
zh: 我是认真的，不幸的是，这对某些人来说是一个大问题。但我告诉美国人民，“我永远不会说谎。”

source: Playboy definitely twisted these words to make them worse than they were. I will apologize profusely to the Johnson family and clarify this statement.
zh: 花花公子绝对扭曲了这些词，使它们变得更糟。我将向约翰逊家人深表歉意并澄清这一声明。

source: I've always believed in trying to change an institution from within. My family has consistently voted against segregation in our church, and will continue to do so.
zh: 我一直相信尝试从内部改变一个机构。我的家人一直投票反对我们教会的种族隔离，并将继续这样做。

source: Our church has been open to some black attendees in the past, but this particular man is already the member of another church, and is clearly a Republican operative.
zh: 我们的教堂过去曾对一些黑人参加者开放，但这个特定的人已经是另一个教堂的成员，并且显然是共和党特工。

source: My family has tried for many years to work for change in the Plains Baptist Church, but I can see now that we have failed. I have no choice but to withdraw my membership.
zh: 我的家人多年来一直试图为平原浸信会教堂的变革而努力，但我现在看到我们失败了。我别无选择，只能退出会员资格。

source: Walter Mondale is a committed liberal and a true friend of Hubert H. Humphrey. He is the kind of man who all Democrats can get behind.
zh: 沃尔特·蒙代尔是一位坚定的自由主义者，也是休伯特·H.·汉弗莱的真正朋友。他是那种所有民主党人都能支持的人。

source: Walter Mondale has served his home state of Minnesota well, and he is the best man for the job.
zh: 沃尔特·蒙代尔很好地服务了他的家乡明尼苏达州，他是这项工作的最佳人选。

source: I disagree strongly and believe that General Brown should be removed from this position for such comments. Israel is one of our most valued allies.
zh: 我强烈反对，并认为布朗将军应该因此类评论而被免职。以色列是我们最有价值的盟友之一。

source: This is definitely something that deserves a reprimand at the very least. I don't agree with these views.
zh: 这绝对是最起码应该受到谴责的事情。我不同意这些观点。

source: I don't have any comment. The General's views are his own.
zh: 我没有任何评论。将军的意见是他自己的。

source: I agree with General Brown, to be honest. We would have never had the Oil Crisis in '73 if we weren't closely aligned with Israel.
zh: 说实话，我同意布朗将军的观点。如果我们没有与以色列紧密结盟，我们就不会在 73 年发生石油危机。

source: Big cities have a higher social burden than most jurisdictions. It's only right that they should receive extra financial help to compensate.
zh: 大城市的社会负担比大多数司法管辖区更高。他们应该获得额外的经济帮助来补偿，这是理所当然的。

source: We have to consider each case individually. New York was a one time thing, and they also had to make significant reforms before this loan was approved.
zh: 我们必须单独考虑每种情况。纽约州是一次性的事情，他们还必须在这笔贷款获得批准之前进行重大改革。

source: I couldn't really comment until I saw what the specifics of the case would be.
zh: 在看到案件的具体情况之前，我无法真正发表评论。

source: These types of bailouts support big government, big labor machine politics at the expense of everyone else. There's no way I would support this kind of deal.
zh: 这些类型的救助以牺牲其他所有人为代价来支持大政府、大劳动力机器政治。我绝对不会支持这种交易。

source: It is time for America to move past this issue. I will issue an immediate pardon if I am elected President.
zh: 美国是时候克服这个问题了。如果我当选总统，我将立即赦免。

source: Millions of American men accepted their responsibilities and served admirably, but I can see the case for an eventual pardon. Perhaps towards the end of my term.
zh: 数以百万计的美国男人接受了他们的责任并做出了令人钦佩的贡献，但我可以看到最终赦免的情况。也许在我的任期即将结束时。

source: I would need to think about this issue a little more before reaching a final decision.
zh: 在做出最终决定之前，我需要更多地考虑这个问题。

source: Of course this war was controversial, but I oppose any pardon for people who evaded their military service. This would not send the right message in a future crisis.
zh: 当然，这场战争是有争议的，但我反对对逃避兵役的人进行任何赦免。这不会在未来的危机中发出正确的信息。

source: I support the passage of this Amendment, and think it is a good thing for America.
zh: 我支持这项修正案的通过，并认为这对美国来说是一件好事。

source: I don't really have a strong statement to make on this Amendment. This is an issue for Congress and the states to decide.
zh: 我对这项修正案并没有什么强烈的声明。这是国会和各州需要决定的问题。

source: We already have too many grounds for the federal government to interfere in the economy. This would add another new set of regulations that we can't afford.
zh: 我们已经有太多理由让联邦政府干预经济。这将增加另一套我们无力承担的新法规。

source: I oppose this Amendment, as many labor unions do, because it would jeopardize protections for female workers in areas such as working hours or tasks.
zh: 我和许多工会一样反对这项修正案，因为它会危及对女工在工作时间或任务等方面的保护。

source: I am opposed to these plans and believe that the courts have erred greatly.
zh: 我反对这些计划，并认为法院犯了很大的错误。

source: I believe that ways can be found to minimize forced busing while also remaining true to the Nation's ideals and our educational goals.
zh: 我相信可以找到方法来最大限度地减少强制乘坐校车，同时也忠于国家的理想和我们的教育目标。

source: I can see both sides of this. It is a hugely disruptive practice, yet we need to fight for integration somehow.
zh: 我可以看到这件事的两面。这是一种极具破坏性的做法，但我们需要以某种方式争取整合。

source: This is a necessary step to enforce the Brown decision and uphold the ideals of America.
zh: 这是执行布朗决定和维护美国理想的必要步骤。

source: As President I will remain vigilant against the Soviet threat. Under no circumstances would I decrease our defense budget.
zh: 作为总统，我将对苏联的威胁保持警惕。在任何情况下我都不会减少我们的国防预算。

source: I don't support cuts, to be sure, but neither do we need increases. We have made great strides in reducing tension with the Soviet Union.
zh: 当然，我不支持削减，但我们也不需要增加。我们在缓和与苏联的紧张关系方面取得了长足进步。

source: Vietnam is over, and détente with the Soviet Union has reduced the need for massive defense expenditures. I believe that any attempt to reduce our deficit should include defense cuts.
zh: 越南战争结束了，与苏联的缓和减少了对大规模国防开支的需求。我认为任何减少赤字的尝试都应该包括削减国防开支。

source: I will uphold the law as President, but I think it should be left to each state to decide. I would support an Amendment on this issue.
zh: 作为总统，我将维护法律，但我认为应该由每个州来决定。我支持就此问题进行修正案。

source: People disagree on this practice and decision, but the Supreme Court deserves our respect.
zh: 人们对这种做法和判决有不同意见，但最高法院值得我们尊重。

source: I'm personally opposed to abortion, but I respect this decision and will not try to overturn it.
zh: 我个人反对堕胎，但我尊重这个决定，不会试图推翻它。

source: I am a pro-choice candidate, and I support the Roe v. Wave decision.
zh: 我是一名支持堕胎的候选人，我支持 罗伊诉波 决定。

source: We need to cultivate relationships like the ones we have with Iran and Saudi Arabia, to ensure that we have support from Middle Eastern oil producers.
zh: 我们需要培养与伊朗和沙特阿拉伯那样的关系，以确保我们得到中东石油生产国的支持。

source: I'm a big supporter of domestic oil production. One thing we can definitely do is begin to drill in Alaska.
zh: 我是国内石油生产的大力支持者。我们绝对可以做的一件事就是开始钻研阿拉斯加州。

source: The crisis resulted from a regional war against Israel. We need to work towards lasting peace agreements to prevent this in the future.
zh: 这场危机是针对以色列的地区战争造成的。我们需要努力达成持久和平协议，以防止未来再次发生这种情况。

source: We need to do anything we can, including reducing our consumption, working for peace deals, producing domestically, and stabilizing our relationships with oil-producing allies.
zh: 我们需要尽一切努力，包括减少消费、争取和平协议、国内生产以及稳定与产油盟友的关系。

source: I am a strong supporter of labor unions and I would support this type of measure.
zh: 我是工会的坚定支持者，我会支持此类措施。

source: This isn't an issue that I have strong feelings about, one way or the other. I think it is the kind of thing that each state can figure out for themselves.
zh: 不管怎样，这不是一个我有强烈感受的问题。我认为这是每个州都可以自己解决的问题。

source: I go more the other way on this issue. I think that more states should be right-to-work. Unions dangerously distort the economy and the political process.
zh: 在这个问题上我更多地采取了另一种方式。我认为应该有更多的州工作权。工会危险地扭曲了经济和政治进程。

source: I believe we should implement an immediate moratorium on the testing of nuclear devices.
zh: 我认为我们应该立即暂停核装置试验。

source: This is an issue I'd have to consider carefully, but perhaps if we got the Soviet Union on board I'd be open to it.
zh: 这是一个我必须仔细考虑的问题，但也许如果我们让苏联加入，我会对此持开放态度。

source: I don't believe so. Our nation's security depends on being adequately prepared to face Soviet aggression.
zh: 我不这么认为。我们国家的安全取决于是否做好充分准备应对苏联的侵略。

source: I don't really care too much one way or the other. As long as we have sufficient supplies in the U.S., we should ship grain to whoever will pay for it.
zh: 我并不太关心其中一种方式。只要美国有足够的供应，我们就应该把粮食运送给谁付钱。

source: This policy is a win-win for us. It helps our own farmers prosper, and it is a public relations victory for the world to see the Soviet Union depending on American enterprise.
zh: 这项政策对我们来说是双赢的。它帮助我们自己的农民繁荣，看到苏联依赖美国企业，这对世界来说是一次公共关系的胜利。

source: This policy helps support an unsustainable Soviet system. I believe that we should never bail out communism from its failures if we're serious about winning the Cold War.
zh: 这项政策有助于支持不可持续的苏联体系。我相信，如果我们真的想赢得冷战，我们就不应该将共产主义从其失败中拯救出来。

source: This is an idea that I support, and I will try my best to see it implemented.
zh: 这是我支持的想法，我会尽力实现它。

source: This is an interesting idea, but I'm more concerned about issues like education and health care.
zh: 这是一个有趣的想法，但我更关心教育和医疗保健等问题。

source: I think the current forms of tax exemptions and aid we have are sufficient. This would be another huge, costly, and complicated program to administer when we are trying to reduce our deficit.
zh: 我认为目前我们拥有的免税和援助形式已经足够了。当我们试图减少赤字时，这将是另一个庞大、昂贵且复杂的管理计划。

source: This kind of idea is way off the mark. We need to focus on reducing the size of government and lowering taxes.
zh: 这种想法完全不切实际。我们需要集中精力减少政府规模和降低税收。

source: I think the fact that this regime collapsed so fast once American troops were gone shows how unsound it really was. We should have never fought the Vietnam War in the first place.
zh: 我认为，一旦美国军队消失，这个政权就崩溃得如此之快，这表明它确实是多么不健全。我们一开始就不应该与越南战争作战。

source: We did our best in Vietnam, but unfortunately things didn't turn out the way we wanted.
zh: 我们在越南尽了最大努力，但不幸的是事情并没有按照我们想要的方式发展。

source: We were trying to provide more aid to South Vietnam, but Congress would not approve additional expenditures. The results of that policy are clear.
zh: 我们试图向南越提供更多援助，但国会不会批准额外支出。该政策的结果是显而易见的。

source: We defeated ourselves throughout this war. American firepower could have knocked North Vietnam into submission if we had been more aggressive.
zh: 在这场战争中我们打败了自己。如果我们更具侵略性，美国的火力可能会让北越屈服。

source: Absolutely I do. We should not tolerate high unemployment in this country, and this Act provides the tools to prevent it.
zh: 我当然愿意。我们不应该容忍这个国家的高失业率，该法案提供了防止这种情况发生的工具。

source: I'm all for some programs to provide jobs, but this Act has too many mandates and goals that are inconsistent with each other. We can't have a balanced budget, full employment, and low inflation at the same time.
zh: 我完全支持一些提供就业机会的计划，但该法案有太多相互不一致的任务和目标。我们不可能同时拥有平衡预算、充分就业和低通胀。

source: I can see both sides of this issue, but if Congress passes this Act I won't veto it as President.
zh: 我可以看到这个问题的两面，但如果国会通过这项法案，我不会作为总统否决它。

source: This Act has no basis in economic reality. If we could wave a magic wand and ensure 3% unemployment and 0% inflation with a balanced budget and no trade deficit, do you think we wouldn't have done it already?
zh: 该法案没有经济现实基础。如果我们能够挥舞魔杖，确保 3% 的失业率和 0% 的通胀率，同时预算平衡且没有贸易赤字，你认为我们不会这么做吗？

source: I would absolutely support a law like this as President. It is past time that our nation had health coverage for all.
zh: 作为总统，我绝对会支持这样的法律。我们国家为所有人提供医疗保险的时代已经过去了。

source: It would depend on things like how the law worked, and how we would pay for it. But I'm not opposed to it in theory.
zh: 这取决于法律如何运作以及我们如何支付费用等因素。但理论上我并不反对。

source: I think it is a noble goal, but it would add too much of a financial burden to the federal budget, which is already running a deficit.
zh: 我认为这是一个崇高的目标，但它会给已经出现赤字的联邦预算增加太多的财政负担。

source: Absolutely not. Not only would this ruin the federal budget, but it would also eliminate competition and lead to substandard health care for the vast majority of Americans.
zh: 绝对不是。这不仅会破坏联邦预算，还会消除竞争并导致绝大多数美国人的医疗保健不合格。

source: Even if permitted, I would hope that our states would move to abolish the death penalty.
zh: 即使允许，我也希望我们的州能够采取行动废除死刑。

source: I'm opposed to the death penalty overall, but I could support it for a few particularly heinous crimes.
zh: 我总体上反对死刑，但对于一些特别令人发指的罪行我可以支持死刑。

source: I'm neutral when it comes to the death penalty. This is an issue for the states to decide.
zh: 我对死刑持中立态度。这是各州需要决定的问题。

source: This is a positive step forward for our criminal justice system. Certain crimes, like murder, demand such punishment if true justice is to prevail.
zh: 这是我们刑事司法系统向前迈出的积极一步。如果真正的正义得以伸张，某些罪行，例如谋杀，就需要这样的惩罚。

source: We will hit the West Coast hard, from Washington, through Oregon, down to California.
zh: 我们将重击西海岸，从华盛顿州，到俄勒冈州，一直到加利福尼亚州。

source: We will focus on the Southwest, starting in New Mexico and Oklahoma, and finishing in Texas.
zh: 我们将重点关注西南地区，从新墨西哥州和俄克拉何马州开始，到得克萨斯州结束。

source: The Midwest is critical. We'll hit as many states as we can between Iowa and Ohio.
zh: 中西部地区至关重要。我们将在艾奥瓦州和俄亥俄州之间触及尽可能多的州。

source: The East Coast -- from Maryland and Pennsylvania to New York and Connecticut.
zh: 东海岸 -- 从马里兰州和宾夕法尼亚州到纽约州和康涅狄格州。

source: Your response is really in tune with the mood of the country.
zh: 你的回应确实符合这个国家的情绪。

source: Political issues are secondary to character issues, and the Democrats are anxious to win after '68 and '72.
zh: 政治问题比品格问题次要，民主党在 68 年和 72 年之后渴望获胜。

source: Political issues are secondary to character issues, and there's no need to pigeonhole yourself yet.
zh: 政治问题相对于性格问题来说是次要的，目前还没有必要将自己归类。

source: Voters want honesty in government, but this message sounds a little strident.
zh: 选民希望政府诚实，但这个信息听起来有点刺耳。

source: Voters do want to hear about your character. Don't downplay it.
zh: 选民确实想听听你的性格。不要轻视它。

source: Voters want honesty in government, but this message sounds a little strident. It is also offensive to the Johnson bloc of the party.
zh: 选民希望政府诚实，但这个信息听起来有点刺耳。这也冒犯了该党的约翰逊集团。

source: For a campaign based on honesty and openness, sitting out the debates does not send a good message.
zh: 你的竞选以诚实和公开为旗帜，拒绝参加辩论可传递不出什么好信号。

source: Unfortunately, Ford performed pretty well in these debates. Furthermore, as the election gets closer, the economy is improving and voters are giving things a closer look...
zh: 不幸的是，福特在这些辩论中表现得相当好。此外，随着选举的临近，经济正在改善，选民也开始更仔细地审视事情......

source: Ford performed well, except for an unfortunate gaffe about the Soviet Union and Eastern Europe. Furthermore, as the election gets closer, the economy is improving and voters are giving things a closer look...
zh: 福特表现良好，除了关于苏联和东欧的不幸失态之外。此外，随着选举的临近，经济正在改善，选民也开始更仔细地审视事情......

source: To be fair, you've appeared with people across the Democratic spectrum, and you shouldn't ignore your Southern base completely.
zh: 公平地说，你与民主党派别的人一起出现过，你不应该完全忽视你的南方基地。

source: This might be true, but there are more people in your Party opposed to Wallace than supportive of him.
zh: 这可能是真的，但你们党内反对华莱士的人多于支持他的人。

source: This might play well in the South, but it definitely detracts from your national appeal.
zh: 这可能在南方很受欢迎，但它肯定会降低你在全国的吸引力。

source: It was a bad idea to do this interview in the first place. The least you can do is show some contrition.
zh: 首先进行这次采访是一个坏主意。你至少可以做的是表现出一些悔悟。

source: It's probably smart to cut your losses and move on from this issue. But for the first time now, a lot of people are questioning your judgment...
zh: 减少损失并继续解决这个问题可能是明智之举。但现在第一次，很多人质疑你的判断……

source: It was a bad idea to do this interview in the first place. You don't need to make things worse by digging your heels in.
zh: 首先进行这次采访是一个坏主意。你不需要固执己见，让事情变得更糟。

source: You've gained a bit for being honest, but this can't be good for your chances in Texas.
zh: 你因诚实而获得了一些好处，但这对你在得克萨斯州中的机会不利。

source: Probably a smart move to walk back from these comments, although it does undermine your claims to honesty by a small amount.
zh: 放弃这些评论可能是明智之举，尽管它确实会稍微削弱您的诚实主张。

source: Unfortunately there's not much you can do with this awkward situation. But you've spoken out enough for Civil Rights that this shouldn't hurt you too much...
zh: 不幸的是，对于这种尴尬的情况你无能为力。但你已经为民权说得够多了，这不会对你造成太大伤害......

source: This answer sounds too strident and waffling to have much appeal on either side. Hopefully the damage is limited.
zh: 这个答案听起来太尖锐和含糊其辞，对任何一方都没有多大吸引力。希望伤害是有限的。

source: It's nice to talk about the New South, but there is sure to be a backlash (especially from the Southern Baptist vote). On the other hand, this could help you a bit elsewhere.
zh: 很高兴谈论新南方，但肯定会出现强烈反对（尤其是美南浸信会投票）。另一方面，这可以在其他方面对您有所帮助。

source: Walter Mondale is a popular choice among mainstream Democrats.
zh: 沃尔特·蒙代尔是主流民主党人的热门选择。

source: This is a strong answer, but it certainly helps you with the Jewish vote in New York and elsewhere.
zh: 这是一个强有力的答案，但它肯定会对您在纽约州和其他地方的犹太人投票有所帮助。

source: This is a good enough answer, but some Jewish supporters were hoping for more.
zh: 这是一个足够好的答案，但一些犹太支持者希望得到更多。

source: Your position on this controversy has become news itself. People are wondering if you're opposed to Israel or the Jewish people, and it is not helping you on the trial.
zh: 你在这场争议中的立场本身已经成为新闻。人们想知道你是否反对以色列或犹太人民，这对你的审判没有帮助。

source: This is a good liberal answer, but perhaps a bit too liberal.
zh: 这是一个很好的自由主义答案，但也许有点太自由主义了。

source: This is not the best response for a Democrat.
zh: 对于民主党人来说，这不是最好的回应。

source: This is a controversial answer, but as an outsider it could help feed your popularity.
zh: 这是一个有争议的答案，但作为局外人，它可以帮助提高你的人气。

source: This is the mainstream answer shared by all major politicians (unless you count a guy like Reagan).
zh: 这是所有主要政客共享的主流答案（除非你算上像里根这样的人）。

source: Even Gerald Ford supports this Amendment. Some wings of the party are pretty disappointed in this stance.
zh: 甚至杰拉尔德·福特也支持该修正案。该党的一些派别对这一立场感到非常失望。

source: Even Gerald Ford supports this Amendment. It's good to win the labor vote, but there are other factors to consider as well.
zh: 甚至杰拉尔德·福特也支持该修正案。赢得工党选票固然很好，但还有其他因素需要考虑。

source: Busing is not a popular policy, but to come out so strongly against it offends some in your party.
zh: 乘坐公交车并不是一项受欢迎的政策，但如此强烈地反对它会冒犯党内的一些人。

source: You've taken the same position as Ford on this issue. But it is probably the majority view at this time.
zh: 您在这个问题上采取了与福特相同的立场。但这可能是目前大多数人的观点。

source: You've offended nobody, but also pleased nobody. There are whispers from some that you can't take a stand on any important issue.
zh: 你没有冒犯任何人，但也没有取悦任何人。有些人私下说你不能在任何重要问题上表明立场。

source: This issue divides your party, and you've cast your lot very clearly. Let's see what happens.
zh: 这个问题分裂了你们的政党，你们的命运已经非常明确了。让我们看看会发生什么。

source: On the balance, your party is surprised to hear you take this stance.
zh: 总的来说，你的政党对你采取这种立场感到惊讶。

source: This is a good, safe answer on the topic.
zh: 这是关于该主题的一个很好、安全的答案。

source: What you've said is true, but you've certainly staked out a liberal position on the issue.
zh: 你所说的是真的，但你在这个问题上肯定表明了自由主义立场。

source: This is another hot-button issue where it might be better for a Democrat to hedge a little.
zh: 这是另一个热点问题，民主党人最好稍微对冲一下。

source: It's hard to know what to do with this question. It might well be best to give a non-committal answer and hope the issue goes away after this election.
zh: 很难知道如何处理这个问题。最好给出一个不置可否的答案，并希望这个问题在这次选举后消失。

source: Some in your party are glad to hear this, but it is also an unpopular position in the South.
zh: 你们党内的一些人很高兴听到这个消息，但这在南方也是一个不受欢迎的立场。

source: Voters don't care much what you do, as long as there are no more gas shortages and long lines at the pump.
zh: 选民不太关心你做什么，只要不再出现天然气短缺和加油站排长队的情况。

source: This certainly helps you with the urban hard hat vote, but it could hurt you in the South, where most states are right-to-work.
zh: 这当然可以帮助您进行城市安全帽投票，但它可能会伤害您在南方的大部分州工作权。

source: This is the type of middle-ground answer that will keep you from alienating any large wing of the party.
zh: 这是一种中间立场的答案，可以防止你疏远党内的任何大派别。

source: This is a big break from the Democratic platform. You'd better be prepared to explain this a little more.
zh: 这是民主党政纲的重大突破。你最好准备好对此进行更多解释。

source: You've definitely come down with the dovish wing of the party on this issue.
zh: 在这个问题上，你肯定是支持党内的鸽派人士的。

source: This is a popular, mainstream answer on this issue. Even Republicans are looking for ways to defuse Cold War tensions these days.
zh: 这是关于这个问题的流行、主流答案。如今，就连共和党人也在寻找缓解冷战紧张局势的方法。

source: You've definitely come down with the hawkish wing of the party on this issue.
zh: 在这个问题上，你肯定是支持了党内的鹰派。

source: This answer is a bit apathetic, and you've missed a good chance to win support from the farm states.
zh: 这个答案有点冷漠，你错过了赢得农场州支持的好机会。

source: A lot of farm states are happy to have another market for their grain, and this is a good foreign policy win as well.
zh: 许多农业州很高兴他们的粮食有另一个市场，这也是外交政策的一个很好的胜利。

source: This might make you look more conservative, but it's not the popular answer for this election.
zh: 这可能会让你看起来更保守，但这不是这次选举的流行答案。

source: McGovern lost pretty badly in '72, if you'll remember. It might not the best strategy to copy his policies.
zh: 如果你还记得的话，麦戈文在 72 年输得很惨。复制他的政策可能不是最好的策略。

source: This a good way to please your liberal base without associating yourself with the McGovern disaster.
zh: 这是一个取悦你的自由派基础的好方法，而又不会让你自己与麦戈文灾难联系在一起。

source: This is not a good way to win support from the Democrats in 1976.
zh: 这不是 1976 年赢得民主党支持的好方法。

source: This is a dovish answer, but one that many Americans agree with.
zh: 这是一个温和的答案，但许多美国人都同意。

source: This puts you at odds with the Democratic Party, but it could help you with the defense hawk types.
zh: 这会让你与民主党产生矛盾，但它可以帮助你处理防御鹰类型。

source: Americans, and particularly Democrats, do not want a President who sounds like this on the Vietnam issue. Let bygones be bygones.
zh: 美国人，尤其是民主党人，不想要一位在越南问题上听起来如此的总统。过去的就让它过去吧。

source: This is a pretty liberal policy, but it's broadly popular with Democrats and particularly important to Hubert Humphrey.
zh: 这是一项相当自由的政策，但它广泛受到民主党人的欢迎，对休伯特来说尤其重要汉弗莱。

source: This is a good chance to present yourself as the voice of common-sense and honesty, but many Democrats favor the proposed law.
zh: 这是一个很好的机会来展示自己作为常识和诚实的声音，但许多民主党人赞成拟议的法律。

source: You have enjoyed broad appeal, but sometimes it is almost too broad. As the election approaches, some voters worry that you can't take a clear stand on many of the issues.
zh: 你享有广泛的吸引力，但有时它几乎太广泛了。随着选举的临近，一些选民担心你无法在许多问题上采取明确的立场。

source: This is a pretty conservative answer for a Democrat. It sounds like something Ronald Reagan might say.
zh: 对于民主党人来说，这是一个相当保守的答案。听起来像是罗纳德·里根可能会说的话。

source: This is a pretty standard answer for a Democrat. Of course, if you're elected, liberals in the party (such as Ted Kennedy) will expect you to take action on this issue.
zh: 对于民主党人来说，这是一个非常标准的答案。当然，如果你当选，党内的自由派（例如特德·肯尼迪）会期望你在这个问题上采取行动。

source: This is another answer that offends nobody, but also pleases nobody.
zh: 这是另一个不会冒犯任何人的答案，但也不会取悦任何人。

source: This is not inspiring stuff to the Democratic base.
zh: 这对民主党基础来说并不是鼓舞人心的东西。

source: Even Ford is less opposed to health care measures than this. You've taken a pretty conservative stance here.
zh: 就连福特也比这更反对医疗保健措施。你在这里采取了相当保守的立场。

source: This is a good, liberal answer, but a bit outside the mainstream.
zh: 这是一个很好、自由的答案，但有点脱离主流。

source: The party has a little more of a nuanced position on this issue.
zh: 该党在这个问题上的立场更加微妙。

source: Settle in and wait for the returns. Hopefully you can hold on for the win!
zh: 安顿下来并等待选举结果。希望你能坚持下去，争取胜利！

source: This is a good enough answer, but some Jewish voters were hoping for more.
zh: 这是一个足够好的答案，但一些犹太选民希望得到更多。

source: This is not the kind of answer that Republicans want to hear.
zh: 这不是共和党人想听到的答案。

source: Some accuse you of flip-flopping after you decided to bail out New York. It's good to emphasize that they passed reforms first.
zh: 有些人指责你在决定保释后反复无常纽约州。值得强调的是，他们首先通过了改革。

source: This would be a good answer, but unfortunately you signed off on the New York bailout. It will take some tortuous logic to explain how this position is consistent with that act.
zh: 这将是一个很好的答案，但不幸的是您签署了纽约州救助计划。需要一些曲折的逻辑来解释这一立场与该法案如何一致。

source: This is not a popular answer with Republicans.
zh: 这不是共和党人普遍接受的答案。

source: You've definitely enjoyed a day of generally positive press coverage with this stance. But behind the scenes, conservatives and veterans are upset.
zh: 你肯定很享受这一天的普遍积极的媒体报道与这种立场。但在幕后，保守派和退伍军人却感到不安。

source: This is the party line, but it's also a controversial issue with much disagreement.
zh: 这是党的路线，但也是一个有争议的问题，分歧很大。

source: This is a good compromise position if you don't want to support the Amendment.
zh: 如果您不想支持该修正案，这是一个很好的折衷立场。

source: This is a good answer to fire up the base. But women voters, including your own wife, are upset with you. Enjoy sleeping on the White House couch for a few days.
zh: 这是一个启动基地的好答案。但女性选民，包括你自己的妻子，对你感到不满。享受在白宫沙发上睡几天的感觉。

source: You've managed to offend everyone with this answer. Sounding conservative and praising labor unions at the same time?
zh: 你的这个答案已经冒犯了所有人。听起来很保守，同时又赞扬工会？

source: Busing is not a popular policy, and there's not that much to lose by coming out against it.
zh: 乘坐公交车并不是一项受欢迎的政策，而且站出来反对也不会造成太大损失。

source: Busing is a pretty unpopular policy, and even more so in your party.
zh: 乘坐公交车是一项非常不受欢迎的政策，在你们的聚会中更是如此。

source: This is a standard, Republican position.
zh: 这是标准的共和党立场。

source: In this day and age, this might be the best stance. Voters like the fact that we're not at war right now.
zh: 在当今时代，这可能是最好的立场。选民喜欢我们现在没有处于战争状态这一事实。

source: You're really thinking outside the box for a Republican. But there will be a backlash.
zh: 你真的是在跳出共和党人的思维框架。但会有反弹。

source: There has been a lot of debate in your party on this issue, but allowing each state to make their own decision is a good compromise, right?
zh: 你们党内对此问题进行了很多辩论，但允许每个州做出自己的决定是一个很好的妥协，对吗？

source: You've come out more strongly in favor of abortion than Carter, or even McGovern did. You're definitely making headlines today.
zh: 你比卡特更强烈地支持堕胎，甚至比麦戈文也更强烈。你今天肯定会成为头条新闻。

source: This is not what your party wants to hear out of you!
zh: 这不是你的政党想从你嘴里听到的！

source: This is the type of middle-ground answer that will keep you in contention, but some conservatives are upset.
zh: 这种中间立场的答案会让你陷入争论，但一些保守派人士对此感到不安。

source: This is a typical Republican position.
zh: 这是典型的共和党立场。

source: Even Republicans are looking for ways to defuse Cold War tensions these days. This is in line with your actions as President thus far.
zh: 如今，甚至共和党人也在寻找缓解冷战紧张局势的方法。这符合您作为总统迄今为止的行动。

source: This isn't that popular of an idea. Even Democrats are divided on it...
zh: 这并不是一个流行的想法。甚至民主党人对此也存在分歧......

source: Hmmm... Republicans are wondering what you mean by this...
zh: 嗯...共和党人想知道你这是什么意思...

source: Give 'em hell, Jerry!
zh: 让他们见鬼去吧，杰瑞！

source: This is a dovish answer, but it repudiates some of your own actions as President.
zh: 这是一个鸽派的答案，但它否定了你作为总统的一些行为。

source: This is the type of middle-ground answer that will keep you from alienating any large segment of voters.
zh: 这是一种中间立场的答案，可以防止你疏远任何一大批选民。

source: This is a good way to stick up for your policies as President, and to show the consequences of a gridlocked Congress.
zh: 这是坚持总统政策并展示国会陷入僵局的后果的好方法。

source: People are whispering that you sound more like Barry Goldwater than Gerald Ford.
zh: 人们窃窃私语说你听起来更像是巴里·戈德华特而不是杰拉尔德·福特。

source: You've certainly just changed your position on this issue. And not in a way that pleases the Republican voters.
zh: 您肯定刚刚改变了在这个问题上的立场。而且不是以一种令共和党选民满意的方式。

source: This is a good chance to present yourself as the voice of common-sense and honesty.
zh: 这是一个很好的机会来展示自己作为常识和诚实的代言人。

source: A lot of Republicans would prefer you veto this law, but on the other hand you do appear reasonable and conciliatory with this response.
zh: 许多共和党人希望您否决这项法律，但另一方面，您的这一回应确实显得合理且和解。

source: People are whispering that you sound more like Ronald Reagan than Gerald Ford.
zh: 人们窃窃私语说你听起来更像是罗纳德·里根而不是杰拉尔德·福特。

source: Your party had a hard time getting on board for Medicare and Medicaid. Perhaps it's not a good idea to support universal health care at this time.
zh: 你们的队伍很难加入联邦医疗保险和医疗补助。也许此时支持全民医疗保健并不是一个好主意。

source: Good hedge. You can't possibly support this idea, but you can oppose it without sounding like a scrooge.
zh: 良好的对冲。你不可能支持这个想法，但你可以反对它，而不会听起来像个守财奴。

source: This is a good answer to fire up the base.
zh: 这是一个启动基地的好答案。

source: It's a brave stance you're taking in this day and age. Let's see how it goes.
zh: 在这个时代，你所采取的立场是勇敢的。让我们看看进展如何。

source: Settle in and wait for the returns. Hopefully you can pull off a comeback for the ages!
zh: 安顿下来并等待选举结果。希望你能东山再起！

source: You have selected Frank Church as your running mate. Can you speak a little more about that?
zh: 您已选择弗兰克·丘奇作为您的竞选搭档。您能多谈谈吗？

source: Do you think that the Panama Canal should be turned back over to Panama?
zh: 您认为巴拿马运河应该归还给巴拿马吗？

source: Do you think that the tax cuts in early 1975 were the right economic policy for this country?
zh: 您认为 1975 年初的减税政策对这个国家来说是正确的经济政策吗？

source: Do you have a position on the gun control issue?
zh: 您对枪支管制问题有何立场？

source: Frank Church has made some recent statements on the campaign trail that even more needs to be done to rein in America's military and intelligence agencies. Do you think he is going too far?
zh: 弗兰克·丘奇最近在竞选活动中发表了一些声明，称需要采取更多措施来控制美国的军事和情报机构。你认为他太过分了吗？

source: I support this as a positive step, and I'm eager to see how current negotiations play out.
zh: 我支持这是积极的一步，并且我渴望看到当前的谈判如何进行。

source: Frank Church is committed to openness in government, and in exposing the kinds of intelligence abuses that all Americans deserve to hear about.
zh: 弗兰克·丘奇致力于政府的开放性，并致力于揭露所有美国人都应该听到的各种情报滥用行为。

source: Frank Church has served his home state of Idaho well, and he is the best man for the job.
zh: 弗兰克·丘奇很好地服务了他的家乡爱达荷州，他是这项工作的最佳人选。

source: Church is an honorable man, but I would never support the weakening of America's fundamental defense abilities. I support investigations, but not cuts to our defense.
zh: 丘奇是一个值得尊敬的人，但我绝不会支持削弱美国的基本防御能力。我支持调查，但不支持削减我们的辩护。

source: I wouldn't phrase it in his manner. I think we can afford some cuts to our defense budget, but as a Navy man myself, I will always respect our military.
zh: 我不会以他的方式表达它。我认为我们可以承受一些国防预算的削减，但作为一名海军人员，我将永远尊重我们的军队。

source: Church is right on the mark. The people still are not in a position where they can trust our leading government institutions, and that includes the military.
zh: 教堂是正确的。人民仍然无法信任我们的主要政府机构，其中包括军队。

source: I think we've done enough in this area. My goal as President will be to move beyond the strife and scandals of the past few years.
zh: 我认为我们在这方面已经做得足够了。作为总统，我的目标是超越过去几年的冲突和丑闻。

source: Unfortunately these cuts were pretty limited. I would prefer larger tax cuts and a reduction in government spending.
zh: 不幸的是，这些削减非常有限。我更倾向于大幅减税和减少政府支出。

source: This was a good policy. Our economy has rebounded considerably since early 1975, and millions of new jobs have been created.
zh: 这是一项好政策。自 1975 年初以来，我们的经济大幅反弹，创造了数百万个新就业机会。

source: Maybe this contributed, but we also increased spending which certainly did its part to stimulate the economy.
zh: 也许这有所贡献，但我们也增加了支出，这无疑为刺激经济做出了贡献。

source: I believe that any recovery that has occurred was incidental to those tax cuts. The cause was a combination of natural economic strength and increased spending.
zh: 我相信所发生的任何复苏都是这些减税的附带结果。原因是自然经济实力和支出增加的结合。

source: Gun control is ineffective in reducing crime rates. I think a better option would be to examine our sentencing guidelines, and make sure that we put criminals in jail.
zh: 枪支管制对于降低犯罪率无效。我认为更好的选择是检查我们的量刑指南，并确保我们将罪犯关进监狱。

source: I'm an opponent of gun control overall, but some common-sense measures like the 1968 Act are appropriate.
zh: 我总体上反对枪支管制，但一些常识性措施（例如 1968 年法案）是适当的。

source: I'd like to see more widespread licensing and registration of handguns and rifles, but it has been repeatedly defeated in the past.
zh: 我希望看到更广泛的手枪和步枪许可和注册，但它在过去屡屡失败。

source: We have a long way to go on this issue, especially in light of the crime we've seen the past ten years. I support strict licensing and confiscation if necessary.
zh: 在这个问题上我们还有很长的路要走，特别是考虑到我们过去十年所看到的犯罪行为。我支持严格许可并在必要时没收。

source: This is an issue I would have to consider more closely over the next couple of years. Let's see how the current negotiations go.
zh: 这是我在未来几年必须更仔细考虑的一个问题。让我们看看目前的谈判进展如何。

source: Absolutely not. The United States built this canal and it is a central part of world commerce. Who knows what might happen if we put Panama in charge.
zh: 绝对不是。美国修建了这条运河，它是世界商业的核心部分。谁知道如果我们让巴拿马掌管会发生什么。

source: You're definitely playing to the urban wing of the party, and sacrificing a bit of support in the South.
zh: 你肯定是在迎合该党的城市派，并牺牲了南方的一些支持。

source: This is not a typical Republican position, but it could help you with the urban wing of the party.
zh: 这不是典型的共和党立场，但它可以帮助您处理该党的城市派别。

source: Frank Church should help burnish your credentials on defense and character issues.
zh: 弗兰克·丘奇应该有助于提高你在防守和品格问题上的资历。

source: It doesn't look good to rebuke your running mate in such a hawkish manner.
zh: 以如此强硬的态度斥责你的竞选搭档看起来不太好。

source: This is a pretty conservative answer for a Democrat.
zh: 对于民主党人来说，这是一个相当保守的答案。

source: You're kind of praising the policies that Ford has enacted. Is this just a bit too honest for an election campaign?
zh: 您有点赞扬福特制定的政策。这只是一点点吗 也是 诚实的竞选活动？

source: This a good liberal answer on economic policy.
zh: 这是关于经济政策的一个很好的自由主义答案。

source: Most in your party disagree. On the other hand, you do come from a region that opposes gun control.
zh: 你们党内的大多数人不同意。另一方面，您确实来自反对枪支管制的地区。

source: Some defense hawks are upset at the idea of conceding the Panama Canal, but others think this will help build positive sentiment for the United States.
zh: 一些国防鹰派对放弃巴拿马运河的想法感到不安，但其他人认为这将有助于为美国树立积极的情绪。

source: Those tax cuts have your name on them. Are you saying they weren't enough?
zh: 这些减税措施上有你的名字。你说他们还不够？

source: You can't lose with this answer. People like your tax cuts, and they're also starting to notice that the economy is getting a lot better this year.
zh: 这个答案你不会输。人们喜欢你们的减税政策，而且他们也开始注意到今年的经济状况有了很大好转。

source: Not only is this answer unorthodox for a Republican, but those tax cuts were your policy!
zh: 对于共和党人来说，这个答案不仅不正统，而且那些减税是你的政策！

source: This an orthodox Republican answer. If only your party could get the South to see the light...
zh: 这是正统的共和党答案。如果你的政党能让南方看到光明就好了……

source: This is a pretty safe answer that appeals to your party without alienating moderates.
zh: 这是一个非常安全的答案，既能吸引你的政党，又不会疏远温和派。

source: This is a good, conservative answer on foreign policy.
zh: 这是关于外交政策的一个很好的、保守的答案。

source: You have selected John Glenn as your running mate. Can you speak a little more about that?
zh: 您已选择约翰·格伦作为您的竞选搭档。您能多谈谈吗？

source: John Glenn is an American hero, and he has the right ideas about government. I'm proud to have him with me.
zh: 约翰·格伦是一位美国英雄，他对政府有正确的看法。我很自豪有他和我在一起。

source: John Glenn has served his home state of Ohio well, and he is the best man for the job.
zh: 约翰·格伦很好地服务了他的家乡俄亥俄州，他是这项工作的最佳人选。

source: John Glenn is a broadly popular choice.
zh: 约翰·格伦是一种广泛流行的选择。

source: You have selected Scoop Jackson as your running mate. Can you speak a little more about that?
zh: 您已选择斯库普·杰克逊作为您的竞选搭档。您能多谈谈吗？

source: Some have suggested that Scoop Jackson is too conservative for the Democratic Party. Can you explain a little why you've selected a defense hawk and anti-busing Senator as your running mate?
zh: 有些人认为斯库普·杰克逊对于民主党来说过于保守。你能解释一下为什么你选择了一位国防鹰派和反滥用权力的参议员作为你的竞选搭档吗？

source: Scoop Jackson has the right ideas about what it means to be a Democrat -- strong on defense, and tireless in his fight for working class American.
zh: 斯库普·杰克逊对于成为一名民主党人意味着什么有着正确的想法——强大的防守能力，以及孜孜不倦地为美国工人阶级而奋斗。

source: Scoop Jackson has served his home state of Washington well, and he is the best man for the job.
zh: 斯库普·杰克逊很好地服务了他的家乡华盛顿州，他是这项工作的最佳人选。

source: Scoop Jackson stands for common-sense American values. I support a strong defense myself, and anyone can get a little concerned over how much the federal courts have interfered with education in this country.
zh: 斯库普·杰克逊代表美国常识价值观。我本人支持强有力的辩护，任何人都可能会有点担心联邦法院对这个国家的教育的干预程度。

source: We might have a few areas in which we have different opinions, but that is what the Democratic Party is all about. Part of running a national campaign is compromising for the good of the whole.
zh: 我们可能在一些领域有不同的意见，但这就是民主党的全部内容。开展全国性运动的一部分是为了整体利益而做出妥协。

source: Scoop Jackson is a polarizing choice, but he has his advantages.
zh: 斯库普·杰克逊是一个两极分化的选择，但他有他的优点。

source: You have selected Bob Dole as your running mate. Can you speak a little more about that?
zh: 您已选择鲍勃·多尔作为您的竞选搭档。您能多谈谈吗？

source: What will your overall campaign strategy be this year?
zh: 今年您的总体竞选策略是什么？

source: A lot of voters are concerned about honesty and integrity in our government. What can you say about yourself in this aspect, particularly in light of your pardon of Richard Nixon?
zh: 许多选民担心我们政府的诚实和正直。在这方面，特别是考虑到您对理查德·尼克松的赦免，您对自己有何评价？

source: Your campaign has just received a big break in the form of a controversial interview that Carter did with Playboy, where he confessed to "committing adultery in his heart" and used some coarse language. Any thoughts?
zh: 你的竞选活动刚刚以卡特与《花花公子》进行的一次有争议的采访形式获得了重大突破，他在采访中承认“内心犯了通奸罪”，并使用了一些粗俗的语言。有什么想法吗？

source: Some of your operatives want to attack Carter for the way he has equivocated on abortion, gun control, busing, labor issues, and so on. Will you approve a series of ads labeling him as a "flip-flopper"?
zh: 你们的一些特工想要攻击卡特，因为他在堕胎、枪支管制、校车、劳工问题等问题上模棱两可。你会批准一系列把他贴上“人字拖”标签的广告吗？

source: Your Secretary of Agriculture, Earl Butz, will be quoted in next week's Rolling Stone as making some very crude and racist jokes. Some have suggested you fire him before the article is released. What are your thoughts?
zh: 你们的农业部长厄尔·巴茨 (Earl Butz) 将在下周的报道中引用 滚石 开了一些非常粗俗和种族主义的玩笑。有些人建议你在文章发表之前解雇他。你有什么想法？

source: You have vetoed a significant number of bills in your two years as President. What was your reasoning?
zh: 您在担任总统的两年内否决了大量法案。你的理由是什么？

source: I am the President of the United States and we should exploit that fact. Show me presiding over the Bicentennial, meeting with Queen Elizabeth, and generally looking like a President. My record speaks for itself.
zh: 我是美国总统，我们应该利用这一事实。让我看看我主持二百周年纪念活动，会见伊丽莎白女王，总体上看起来像个总统。我的记录不言而喻。

source: We barely defeated Ronald Reagan to win our nomination in the first place. We should take conservative positions and make sure we shore up our support in that area.
zh: 我们勉强击败了罗纳德·里根，赢得了第一名的提名。我们应该采取保守立场，并确保加强我们在该领域的支持。

source: Who is this Jimmy Carter person anyway? He's untested and takes both sides of every important issue. We need to make sure people understand that.
zh: 这个吉米·卡特人到底是谁？他未经考验，在每个重要问题上都持两面立场。我们需要确保人们理解这一点。

source: I'm an approachable, open guy with an open Administration. Let's emphasize my mainstream values and positions, and avoid extremist rhetoric or attacks on Jimmy Carter.
zh: 我是一个平易近人、开放的人，有着开放的政府。让我们强调我的主流价值观和立场，避免极端主义言论或对吉米·卡特的攻击。

source: I will let the cameras into the White House so the people can see for themselves. I'm a normal, approachable, friendly President. I didn't spend my whole life trying to run for the office.
zh: 我会让摄像机进入白宫，这样人们就可以亲眼看到。我是一位正常、平易近人、友好的总统。我并没有花费一生的时间去竞选公职。

source: I've taken our country and led it past the nightmares of Watergate and Vietnam. Anyone can see that I've led an open, honest Administration.
zh: 我已经带领我们的国家度过了水门事件和越南的噩梦。任何人都可以看到我领导了一个开放、诚实的政府。

source: Honesty and integrity is one thing, but voters want to hear about solutions. I've led our economy back from a steep recession while passing a tax cut for the American people.
zh: 诚实和正直是一回事，但选民希望听到解决方案。我带领我们的经济从严重衰退中复苏，同时通过了美国人民的减税政策。

source: What about the honesty and integrity of Jimmy Carter? Whether it's abortion, gun control, busing, or labor, he's taken both sides of too many issues to count.
zh: 吉米·卡特的诚实和正直怎么样？无论是堕胎、枪支管制、校车还是劳工，他都考虑过太多问题的双方。

source: I agree. We can't have this kind of thing on the Ford Administration. He should leave immediately.
zh: 我同意。我们福特政府不能有这种事情。他应该立即离开。

source: Let's have him leave the day that the article comes out. That way the connection is clear.
zh: 让他在文章发表的那天离开吧。这样一来，联系就清晰了。

source: Let's wait and see and how the public reacts to this.
zh: 让我们拭目以待公众对此有何反应。

source: A couple of bad jokes shouldn't ruin someone's career. Let's keep him on board.
zh: 几个糟糕的笑话不应该毁掉某人的职业生涯。让我们把他留在船上吧。

source: Not really. I'm the President and Carter is an upstart from Georgia. Let's keep it that way.
zh: 并非如此。我是总统，卡特是佐治亚州的暴发户。让我们保持这种状态吧。

source: I think this is a good idea, and we need something to shake this campaign up.
zh: 我认为这是一个好主意，我们需要一些东西来改变这场运动。

source: This is an issue that has been blown way out of proportion. In many of these cases, I've proposed my own alternative to a given bill, and Congress has acted on it.
zh: 这个问题已经被夸大了。在许多这样的情况下，我提出了我自己的特定法案的替代方案，并且国会已经采取了行动。

source: The Democrats, with their huge majorities, have passed bill after bill outside of the American mainstream. I've been left with little choice.
zh: 民主党以绝对多数通过了美国主流之外的一项又一项法案。我别无选择。

source: Congress is simply too liberal to be a useful partner in government right now. I hope that the American people will elect Republican congressman to be my partners over the next four years.
zh: 国会过于自由，目前无法成为政府的有用合作伙伴。我希望美国人民选举共和党国会议员作为我未来四年的合作伙伴。

source: The American people deserve to hear the truth. I support this strategy.
zh: 美国人民应该听到真相。我支持这个策略。

source: Maybe some limited spots, asking if we really know who Jimmy Carter is. Or attacking him on one of these issues. But let's not go overboard.
zh: 也许有一些有限的位置，询问我们是否真的知道吉米·卡特是谁。或者在这些问题之一上攻击他。但我们不要太过分。

source: The problem is, if we go negative against Carter, he's sure to hammer us on the Nixon pardon. We really have a lot to lose here.
zh: 问题是，如果我们对卡特持否定态度，他肯定会在尼克松赦免上严厉打击我们。我们真的在这里失去了很多。

source: This is great. We need any good news we can get at this point.
zh: 这太棒了。我们现在需要任何能得到的好消息。

source: I will hold a press conference and remind people that we really don't know anything about this guy. What other hidden, perverse notions does he have?
zh: 我会召开新闻发布会并提醒人们，我们真的对这个人一无所知。他还有什么不可告人的邪念呢？

source: Bob Dole is a staunch conservative who really sets the tone for the direction I want to take.
zh: 鲍勃·多尔是一位坚定的保守派，他真正为我想要走的方向定下了基调。

source: Bob Dole is the type of Republican that the entire party can get behind, and he has served his home state of Kansas well.
zh: 鲍勃·多尔是那种全党都可以支持的共和党人，他为自己的家乡堪萨斯州州服务得很好。

source: This is probably your best strategy. The voters like Carter for now, but hopefully some will think twice about his leadership as election day approaches.
zh: 这可能是你最好的策略。选民目前喜欢卡特，但希望随着选举日的临近，一些人会重新考虑他的领导能力。

source: Reagan's supporters are just a vocal minority right now. It's good to unite the party, but will this really help you beat Jimmy Carter in 1976?
zh: 里根的支持者现在只是少数。团结党固然好，但这真的能帮助你在1976年击败吉米·卡特吗？

source: It's risky to attack Carter so heavily. Voters like him as a person -- even some who might be on the fence out his politics or readiness for office.
zh: 如此猛烈地攻击卡特是有风险的。选民们喜欢他这个人，甚至有些选民可能对他的政治观点或是否准备就职持观望态度。

source: This is a good strategy. You need to make the case that you've also acted with integrity in office, given the climate of this year's election.
zh: 这是一个很好的策略。考虑到今年选举的气氛，你需要证明你在任期间也表现得正直。

source: This is out of step with the current mood. Voters do want to hear about honesty and integrity.
zh: 这与当前的情绪不相符。选民 做 想听听有关诚实和正直的内容。

source: It's risky to attack Carter so heavily. Voters like him as a person -- even some who might be on the fence about his politics or readiness for office.
zh: 如此猛烈地攻击卡特是有风险的。选民们喜欢他这个人，甚至有些选民可能对他的政治观点或就职准备持观望态度。

source: This is a good, proactive step that helped minimize the damage from Butz's gaffe.
zh: 这是一个很好的、主动的步骤，有助于最大限度地减少巴茨失态造成的损害。

source: The reaction is not too good, overall. You quickly decide that Butz must go, but you got a couple days of embarrassing press first.
zh: 总体来说反应不太好。你很快就决定巴茨必须离开，但你首先受到了几天尴尬的媒体报道。

source: Eventually, after a few days of uproar, your party makes it clear that Butz must go. Unfortunately, this has been a huge distraction and has made you look pretty bad on the evening news.
zh: 最终，经过几天的骚动，你们的政党明确表示巴茨必须下台。不幸的是，这会分散你的注意力，让你在晚间新闻中看起来很糟糕。

source: You need any help you can get right now. Why would you not want to debate on national television?
zh: 您现在需要任何可以获得的帮助。你为什么不想在国家电视台辩论？

source: You performed pretty well in these debates. Furthermore, as the election gets closer, the economy is improving and voters are giving things a closer look...
zh: 你在这些辩论中表现得很好。此外，随着选举的临近，经济正在改善，选民也开始更仔细地审视事情......

source: You performed well, except for an unfortunate gaffe about the Soviet Union and Eastern Europe. Furthermore, as the election gets closer, the economy is improving and voters are giving things a closer look...
zh: 除了关于苏联和东欧的不幸失态之外，你表现得很好。此外，随着选举的临近，经济正在改善，选民也开始更仔细地审视事情......

source: It is true that relations with Congress have been stormy. But what else can you expect when the House is mostly Democrat, and you're a Republican?
zh: 确实，与国会的关系一直很紧张。但是，当众议院多数是民主党人而你是共和党人时，你还能指望什么呢？

source: This is a nice thing to hope for, but for the moment there are a lot of popular Democratic Congressmen in states that you need to win. Tactfulness might be the better strategy.
zh: 这是一件值得期待的好事情，但目前你需要赢得很多州里有很多受欢迎的民主党国会议员。机智可能是更好的策略。

source: The attacks do stick a little bit, but the issue of your Nixon pardon always lingers in the background.
zh: 攻击确实有点持续，但你的尼克松赦免问题总是在后台徘徊。

source: This is probably the best strategy. A few attacks on legitimate issues, but not so many that your campaign looks petty and negative.
zh: 这可能是最好的策略。对合法问题进行一些攻击，但不要太多，以免你的竞选活动显得琐碎和消极。

source: Fair enough. This doesn't really hurt you, but you need things to break your way fast if you're going to catch up with Carter.
zh: 很公平。这并不会真正伤害你，但如果你想追上卡特，你需要一些东西来快速突破你的道路。

source: This is a no-brainer. Just sit back and let Carter shoot himself in the foot.
zh: 这是理所当然的。坐下来，让卡特搬起石头砸自己的脚。

source: Voters are talking about Carter's poor judgment in doing a Playboy interview -- and about your weird, awkward attempt to pile on...
zh: 选民们正在谈论卡特在接受《花花公子》采访时的错误判断 - 以及你奇怪、尴尬的试图堆积......

source: Bob Dole is an unexpected choice for running mate, but it could work out well this fall.
zh: 鲍勃·多尔对于竞选搭档来说是一个意想不到的选择，但今年秋天可能会取得很好的效果。

source: You have selected Howard Baker as your running mate. Can you speak a little more about that?
zh: 您已选择霍华德·贝克作为您的竞选搭档。您能多谈谈吗？

source: Howard Baker knows how to get things done in Washington, and he has always fought hard for the Republican agenda.
zh: 霍华德·贝克知道如何在华盛顿办成事情，也始终为共和党的议程奋力争取。

source: Howard Baker has served his home state of Tennessee well, and he is the best man for the job.
zh: 霍华德·贝克很好地服务了他的家乡田纳西州，他是这项工作的最佳人选。

source: Howard Baker is a good guy to have at your side.
zh: 霍华德·贝克是一个在你身边的好人。

source: Howard Baker is a good guy to have at your side. Just don't expect him to help much in Tennessee against a guy like Carter.
zh: 霍华德·贝克是一个在你身边的好人。只是不要指望他在田纳西州中对抗像卡特这样的人有多大帮助。

source: You have selected John Anderson as your running mate. Can you speak a little more about that?
zh: 您已选择约翰·安德森作为您的竞选搭档。您能多谈谈吗？

source: Ronald Reagan and some of his allies can't hide their disappointment in your running mate, and some of them are even saying Carter is better than a Ford-Anderson Administration. Do you have any comment?
zh: 罗纳德·里根和他的一些盟友无法掩饰他们对你的竞选搭档的失望，他们中的一些人甚至说卡特比福特 - 安德森政府更好。您有何评论？

source: Betty Ford is out there making some pretty bold statements about sexuality, marijuana, and other topics. Conservatives want to know if you can have a quiet chat with her to tone it down a bit.
zh: 贝蒂·福特就性、大麻和其他话题发表了一些相当大胆的言论。保守派想知道你是否可以与她安静地交谈一下，以缓和一点气氛。

source: I've tried to explain to her that we have an election coming up, and we don't need all this bad press, but she won't listen.
zh: 我试图向她解释我们即将举行选举，我们不需要所有这些负面新闻，但她不听。

source: What do you want me to say? She's my wife. Can't people find something better to worry about?
zh: 你想让我说什么？她是我的妻子。人们就不能找到更好的事情来担心吗？

source: My wife's public approval rating is something like 75%. I wish I had her touch with the media.
zh: 我妻子的公众支持率约为 75%。我希望我能与她接触媒体。

source: John Anderson always speaks his mind and fights for what he believes in. These are the kind of people we need in my next Administration.
zh: 约翰·安德森总是说出自己的想法并为自己的信仰而奋斗。这些就是我们下一届政府需要的人。

source: John Anderson has served his home state of Illinois well, and he is the best man for the job.
zh: 约翰·安德森很好地服务了他的家乡伊利诺伊州，他是这项工作的最佳人选。

source: John Anderson is a lifelong Republican and he has the right views on all the important issues for our country. We need a guy like him if we hope to win the independent voters away from Jimmy Carter.
zh: 约翰·安德森是一位终身共和党人，他对我们国家的所有重要问题都有正确的看法。如果我们希望从吉米·卡特中赢得独立选民，我们就需要像他这样的人。

source: I think if Ronald Reagan hopes for a future in this party, he'd better toe the party line when it comes to our election this fall.
zh: 我认为，如果罗纳德·里根希望在这个党中拥有未来，他最好在今年秋天的选举中遵守党的路线。

source: Anderson is an interesting choice. Let's see how it works out.
zh: 安德森是一个有趣的选择。让我们看看效果如何。

source: Your base is a bit deflated at the choice of Anderson. There's no other way to really put it. Let's hope you can win the Midwest this fall to compensate.
zh: 你的基地对安德森的选择有点泄气。没有其他方法可以真正表达它。希望你能在今年秋天赢得中西部冠军以弥补损失。

source: Reagan has a substantial following among Republicans, and you should probably be more diplomatic when you talk about him.
zh: 里根在共和党人中拥有大量追随者，当你谈论他时，你可能应该更加外交化。

source: You have selected John Connally as your running mate. Can you speak a little more about that?
zh: 您已选择约翰·康纳利作为您的竞选搭档。您能多谈谈吗？

source: John Connally has served his home state of Texas well, and he is the best man for the job.
zh: 约翰·康纳利很好地服务了他的家乡得克萨斯州，他是这项工作的最佳人选。

source: Connally was a loyal Democrat for many years, but anyone can see how their party has lurched away from the mainstream. I think he can remind Americans that Republicans are the sensible, governing party in this country.
zh: 康纳利多年来一直是忠诚的民主党人，但任何人都可以看到他们的政党如何偏离主流。我认为他可以提醒美国人，共和党是这个国家明智的执政党。

source: Hopefully, Connally can help you win Texas. Even if he's conservative on some issues, he's also a big time insider and a long-time Democrat.
zh: 希望康纳利可以帮助你赢得得克萨斯州。尽管他在某些问题上持保守态度，但他也是一位重要的内部人士和长期的民主党人。
